body: FIRST RULE SHIPPED — increment_substance_veto (full-column contiguous+unique check). Gold 728->738/931 (0.782->0.793), increment FP 17->7 (P 0.056->0.125), integer recall 0.796->0.847 (+10 recovered), ZERO regressions (per-label diff: only increment/integer moved). Corpus-honest gate GO, zero triggers (categorical mover is confirmed-correct GROWTH 39653->45545; utc/etc collapses have base_correct=0, pre-existing pipeline not this fix). Root cause: value_sharpen's sequential check runs on the 100-value STEPPED sample which can't see contiguity, over-emitting increment. Implemented as guard in apply_post_sharpen_guards using full-column values + pure helper values_form_increment (4 unit tests). ac-03 (cardinality->categorical) NOT done: found ALREADY gate-falsified — R32 comment shows the broad entity_name/city/plain_text variant died at the corpus-honest gate round 1 (3752+2115 oracle-refuted); R32 ships the safe word-only slice. ac-04 binary domain deferred (low gold support). NOTE: this is a Sharpen rule (no model swap); PATCH release bundles it later.
